role: anima dedicated Akida neuromorphic host — NOT shared pool compute
hardware: Raspberry Pi 5 + BrainChip AKD1000 (Akida neuromorphic accelerator)
schema_purpose: provenance ledger — every component tagged user_authored vs os_default, each with remove/restore commands so it can be swapped / upgraded / removed cleanly later

pool_roster.note: registered in ~/.pool/pool.json but shared:false; pool load-balancer never routes generic compute here

power_root_cause_2026_06_02.symptom: host repeatedly went DARK / flapping (briefly ALIVE then 'No route to host'), needed MANUAL revival; killed a ~30min Lane-A abs_margin on-chip run mid-fire
power_root_cause_2026_06_02.false_lead: unattended-upgrades auto-reboot — user disabled it (52anima-no-autoreboot drop-in) but deaths CONTINUED, because auto-reboot was never the cause (Automatic-Reboot already false).
power_root_cause_2026_06_02.actual_cause: UNDER-VOLTAGE BROWNOUT. vcgencmd get_throttled=0x50000 (bit16 under-voltage occurred + bit18 throttling occurred); EXT5V rail sagging to 4.87V under AKD1000 (PCIe 0000:01:00.0) + spike-streamer load; abrupt power loss left no journal flush (=no clean-shutdown/panic log = power-cut signature).
power_root_cause_2026_06_02.fix: PHYSICAL PSU SWAP (user, 2026-06-02). Post-swap reboot 07:54Z: throttled=0x0, EXT5V=5.033V even at higher core draw (1.88A vs prior 1.63A) = headroom. Root cause PROVEN.
power_root_cause_2026_06_02.instrumentation_added: anima-pwr-log user timer (60s) logs throttled+EXT5V+temp to ~/anima_metrology/pwr.log so any recurrence is timestamped; persistent journal dir /var/log/journal present (Storage=auto) for next-death post-mortem.

components.name: spike-streamer.service
components.purpose: anima 자연발화 HW — AKD1000 spike stream (24h, regime R3)

ops.remove: systemctl --user disable --now spike-streamer && rm ~/.config/systemd/user/spike-streamer.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload
ops.edit_regime_or_duration: edit ~/.config/systemd/user/spike-streamer.service ExecStart args, then: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user restart spike-streamer

components.purpose: AKIDA HW/SW integration toolkit (spike stream + first inference + edge learn + LAN boot/status)

ops.upgrade: git pull in the source repo, re-sync to host; OR scp updated script then systemctl --user restart spike-streamer

components.note: OS-shipped, NOT anima. CPU ~0%, unrelated to fan.

ops.disable: sudo systemctl disable --now unattended-upgrades  (optional; not recommended on a networked host)

components.purpose: disable unattended-upgrades AUTO-REBOOT — security updates still install, reboot becomes manual-only; prevents an OS auto-reboot from killing a long on-chip experiment (an auto-reboot lost a ~30min Lane-A abs_margin run on 2026-06-02)
components.note: overrides os_default unattended-upgrades BEHAVIOR only; the daemon stays enabled+active (os_default untouched). Sets Automatic-Reboot "false" + Automatic-Reboot-WithUsers "false".

components.cadence: every 60s (OnUnitActiveSec=60, OnBootSec=30, Persistent=true, linger=yes → runs at boot)
components.purpose: power watchdog — logs vcgencmd get_throttled + EXT5V_V + temp so a future under-voltage/brownout (the 2026-06-02 death cause) is timestamped and provable. Read-only, vcgencmd needs no sudo.

ops.remove: systemctl --user disable --now anima-pwr-log.timer && rm ~/.config/systemd/user/anima-pwr-log.{timer,service} ~/anima_pwr_log.sh && systemctl --user daemon-reload
ops.restore: re-deploy the 3 files then: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now anima-pwr-log.timer

components.purpose: logging · remote access · kernel — Ubuntu base, NOT anima
components.note: do not remove; required for the host to function.

swap_upgrade_remove_guide.to_silence_fan: systemctl --user stop spike-streamer   (re-spins on reboot unless disabled)
to_fully_remove_anima_from_host: # OS-default daemons left untouched — host returns to clean Ubuntu state
swap_upgrade_remove_guide.to_upgrade_streamer: scp new spike_streamer.py to host → systemctl --user restart spike-streamer
swap_upgrade_remove_guide.principle: user_authored components are removable/swappable without touching os_default; os_default must stay for the host to run
